summary: Fixes a DR restore-orchestration defect found during E8 preflight: no numbered restore stage restored the Phase-D protected_updater component, so a schema-2 archive requiring it could never pass final restore validation. Adds deploy/restore/75-protected-updater.sh (locate/validate/publish/record-receipt, same shape as stages 50/70), a small library addition, and a new manage.py command. Never starts/enables/reloads anything; no new protected-runtime generation.
